verses.he: נִבְחָ֣ר שֵׁ֭ם מֵעֹ֣שֶׁר רָ֑ב מִכֶּ֥סֶף וּ֝מִזָּהָ֗ב חֵ֣ן טֽוֹב׃
verses.en: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, And loving favour rather than silver and gold.

verses.he: עָשִׁ֣יר וָרָ֣שׁ נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ עֹשֵׂ֖ה כֻלָּ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: The rich and the poor meet together— The LORD is the maker of them all.

verses.he: עָר֤וּם׀ רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה ויסתר [וְנִסְתָּ֑ר] וּ֝פְתָיִ֗ים עָבְר֥וּ וְֽנֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.en: A prudent man seeth the evil, and hideth himself; But the thoughtless pass on, and are punished.

verses.he: עֵ֣קֶב עֲ֭נָוָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְכָב֣וֹד וְחַיִּֽים׃
verses.en: The reward of humility is the fear of the LORD, Even riches, and honour, and life.

verses.he: צִנִּ֣ים פַּ֭חִים בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עִקֵּ֑שׁ שׁוֹמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ יִרְחַ֥ק מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward; He that keepeth his soul holdeth himself far from them.

verses.he: חֲנֹ֣ךְ לַ֭נַּעַר עַל־פִּ֣י דַרְכּ֑וֹ גַּ֥ם כִּֽי־יַ֝זְקִ֗ין לֹֽא־יָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.en: Train up a child in the way he should go, And even when he is old, he will not depart from it.

verses.he: עָ֭שִׁיר בְּרָשִׁ֣ים יִמְשׁ֑וֹל וְעֶ֥בֶד לֹ֝וֶ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ מַלְוֶֽה׃
verses.en: The rich ruleth over the poor, And the borrower is servant to the lender.

verses.he: זוֹרֵ֣עַ עַ֭וְלָה יקצור [יִקְצָר]־אָ֑וֶן וְשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָת֣וֹ יִכְלֶֽה׃
verses.en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity; And the rod of his wrath shall fail.

verses.he: טֽוֹב־עַ֭יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־נָתַ֖ן מִלַּחְמ֣וֹ לַדָּֽל׃
verses.en: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; For he giveth of his bread to the poor.

verses.he: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְיֵצֵ֣א מָד֑וֹן וְ֝יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת דִּ֣ין וְקָלֽוֹן׃
verses.en: Cast out the scorner, and contention will go out; Yea, strife and shame will cease.

verses.he: אֹהֵ֥ב טהור [טְהָר]־לֵ֑ב חֵ֥ן שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו רֵעֵ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.en: He that loveth pureness of heart, That hath grace in his lips, the king shall be his friend.

verses.he: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה נָ֣צְרוּ דָ֑עַת וַ֝יְסַלֵּ֗ף דִּבְרֵ֥י בֹגֵֽד׃
verses.en: The eyes of the LORD preserve him that hath knowledge, But He overthroweth the words of the faithless man.

verses.he: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל אֲרִ֣י בַח֑וּץ בְּת֥וֹךְ רְ֝חֹב֗וֹת אֵֽרָצֵֽחַ׃
verses.en: The sluggard saith: ‘There is a lion without; I shall be slain in the streets.’

verses.he: שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקָּה פִּ֣י זָר֑וֹת זְע֥וּם יְ֝הוָ֗ה יפול [יִפָּל]־שָֽׁם׃
verses.en: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: He that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.

verses.he: אִ֭וֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָ֣ה בְלֶב־נָ֑עַר שֵׁ֥בֶט מ֝וּסָ֗ר יַרְחִיקֶ֥נָּה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child; But the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

verses.he: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל לְהַרְבּ֣וֹת ל֑וֹ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.en: One may oppress the poor, yet will their gain increase; One may give to the rich, yet will want come.

verses.he: הַ֥ט אָזְנְךָ֗ וּ֭שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֑ים וְ֝לִבְּךָ֗ תָּשִׁ֥ית לְדַעְתִּֽי׃
verses.en: Incline thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, And apply thy heart unto my knowledge.

verses.he: כִּֽי־נָ֭עִים כִּֽי־תִשְׁמְרֵ֣ם בְּבִטְנֶ֑ךָ יִכֹּ֥נוּ יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו עַל־שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; Let them be established altogether upon thy lips.

verses.he: לִהְי֣וֹת בַּ֭יהוָה מִבְטַחֶ֑ךָ הוֹדַעְתִּ֖יךָ הַיּ֣וֹם אַף־אָֽתָּה׃
verses.en: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made them known to thee this day, even to thee.

verses.he: הֲלֹ֤א כָתַ֣בְתִּי לְ֭ךָ שלשום [שָׁלִישִׁ֑ים] בְּמ֖וֹעֵצֹ֣ת וָדָֽעַת׃
verses.en: Have not I written unto thee excellent things Of counsels and knowledge;

verses.he: לְהוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֗ קֹ֭שְׁטְ אִמְרֵ֣י אֱמֶ֑ת לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֲמָרִ֥ים אֱ֝מֶ֗ת לְשֹׁלְחֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth, That thou mightest bring back words of truth to them that send thee?

verses.he: אַֽל־תִּגְזָל־דָּ֭ל כִּ֣י דַל־ה֑וּא וְאַל־תְּדַכֵּ֖א עָנִ֣י בַשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.en: Rob not the weak, because he is weak, Neither crush the poor in the gate;

verses.he: כִּֽי־יְ֭הוָה יָרִ֣יב רִיבָ֑ם וְקָבַ֖ע אֶת־קֹבְעֵיהֶ֣ם נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.en: For the LORD will plead their cause, And despoil of life those that despoil them.

verses.he: אַל־תִּ֭תְרַע אֶת־בַּ֣עַל אָ֑ף וְאֶת־אִ֥ישׁ חֵ֝מוֹת לֹ֣א תָבֽוֹא׃
verses.en: Make no friendship with a man that is given to anger; And with a wrathful man thou shalt not go;

verses.he: פֶּן־תֶּאֱלַ֥ף ארחתו [אֹֽרְחֹתָ֑יו] וְלָקַחְתָּ֖ מוֹקֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.en: Lest thou learn his ways, And get a snare to thy soul.

verses.he: אַל־תְּהִ֥י בְתֹֽקְעֵי־כָ֑ף בַּ֝עֹרְבִ֗ים מַשָּׁאֽוֹת׃
verses.en: Be thou not of them that strike hands, Or of them that are sureties for debts;

verses.he: אִם־אֵֽין־לְךָ֥ לְשַׁלֵּ֑ם לָ֥מָּה יִקַּ֥ח מִ֝שְׁכָּבְךָ֗ מִתַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: If thou hast not wherewith to pay, Why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

verses.he: אַל־תַּ֭סֵּג גְּב֣וּל עוֹלָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Remove not the ancient landmark, Which thy fathers have set.

verses.he: חָזִ֡יתָ אִ֤ישׁ׀ מָ֘הִ֤יר בִּמְלַאכְתּ֗וֹ לִֽפְנֵֽי־מְלָכִ֥ים יִתְיַצָּ֑ב בַּל־יִ֝תְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵ֥י חֲשֻׁכִּֽים׃
verses.en: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; He shall not stand before mean men.
